title: Nana Vich Pardes Dai Lutya Mera Ghar Lokan Nai
body:
Mainu Bazaaran Cha Karvayai Safar Lokan Nay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Rayiaan Pathraan Diyan Barsaatan, Ch Khutbe Pardi
Veer Nu Ro Na Sakee, Duniya Tou Nana Dardee
Mere Khutbay Da Leya Kuj Na Asar Loka Nai.
<<DIVIDER>>
May Muhammad Di Navasee Haan Dasain Di Rayaan
Waasta Tera Vi Main Nana Pavainde Rayaan
Fair Vee Maar Ditay Meray Putar Lokan Nai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jeri Gaardan Nu Tu Chum Da Reya Nana Sayeen
Jo Oda Hal Hoya Bhulna Na Nai Mehshar Tayeen
Os Gaardan Tay Chala Chor Khanjar Lokan Nai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Waal Nazay Tay Rida Shimar Lahahi Aa Kay
Mainu Bazaran Day Vich Turaiya Rassian Paa Kay
Sath Maray Meray Akbar Asghar Lokan Nai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jinu Burkay Ch Kayee Saal Palaindee Rayaan
Aap Jaagan Onu Seenay Tay  Suvaindee Rayaan
Cheer Chadaya Oda Karbal Cha Jigar Lokan Nai
<<DIVIDER>>
Keewain Bazaara Dee Halate Suno De Akhtar
Sani-e-Zahra Pe Waastade Rahay Jis Da Pathar
Alay Ahmed Ki Beti Kis Kadar Lokhan Nai.
